CREATE TABLE `academicYears` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `yearName` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `displayName` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('active','draft') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `isCurrentYear` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `studentSelectionStart` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `studentSelectionEnd` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `teacherConfirmStart` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `teacherConfirmEnd` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `maxWishesNormal` int DEFAULT 5,
  `maxWishesTransfer` int DEFAULT 8,
  `effectiveWishes` int DEFAULT 5,
  `statementRequired` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `chineseTeacherQuota` int DEFAULT 5,
  `thesisUploadStart` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `thesisUploadEnd` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `scoringStart` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `scoringEnd` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `transferStudentSelectionStart` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `transferStudentSelectionEnd` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `topics` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `teacherId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `titleEn` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `descriptionEn` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `requiredSkills` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `suitableMajor` enum('electronic_info','communication','both') DEFAULT 'both',
  `status` enum('draft','published','used') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `isCurrentYear` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `keywords` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `researchFocus` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `thesisType` varchar(64) DEFAULT '毕业设计',
  `topicSource` varchar(64) DEFAULT '其他',
  `topicLanguage` varchar(16) DEFAULT '英语',
  `researchProjectName` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `language` varchar(16) DEFAULT '英语',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
